verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe found a machine-readable OpenAPI document publicly downloadable at docs.synctera.com/openapi.json: it returned HTTP 200 and contains the "openapi" key. That directly delivers the story. Missing for 10: first-party documentation pointing users to the spec download, and evidence of the spec's version and completeness across the v2 API surface.
